comment: Letta Web production bundle budget, checked by scripts/ci/web-bundle-budget.py in the web-wasm job (letta-mobile-hv54v).
Ceilings are gzip bytes (level 9) of what a visitor downloads: the page's wasm and script before the first frame, the Iroh transport on the first connect, the mascot runtime and file when it shows.

Each ceiling sits about 3% above the size measured when it was set (Iroh 5%, since local and CI Rust toolchains differ by about 1%). Ceilings only come down: lower one when a change shrinks its group; never raise one to make a build pass.

kotlin-app-and-skiko-wasm.notes: The Kotlin/Wasm app (16.1 MiB raw) and the Skiko runtime (8.2 MiB raw), main at 101433a40.

iroh-transport.notes: After the size-optimised release profile in native/iroh-wasm/Cargo.toml (was 1,543,306 gzip / 5,145,817 raw; now 2,913,966 raw).
